newsitem.title: FINLAND: Talentum says has had Startel co-op talks.
newsitem.headline: Talentum says has had Startel co-op talks.

text.p: Finnish media house Talentum Oy said in a statement on Friday it had been approached by and held exploratory talks with media group Sanoma Oy on cooperation with Sanoma's real-time news agency Startel Oy.

"Sanoma Osakeyhtio has inquired about Talentum's interest in cooperation with Startel and representatives of the companies have met. Exploratory negotiations on the issue have been held," Talentum said, adding its board had not handled the matter.

Sanoma's flagship newspaper Helsingin Sanomat and other Finnish media on Friday reported that Sanoma planned to launch a business daily to be published five days per week, plus electronic real-time news in some form.
Talentum's major publication is business weekly Talouselama.
